name: Tomb Entrance
description: You stand at the entrance to the Tomb of the Dark Wizard. Ancient stone blocks line the walls, carved with warnings in a forgotten tongue. A heavy iron door to the south leads deeper into the tomb. A torch bracket on the wall holds a single unlit torch.

name: The Burial Chamber
description: You are in the burial chamber of the Dark Wizard. Stone sarcophagi line the walls, and the air reeks of ancient death. In the center of the room rests a glittering treasure chest. Something stirs in the darkness.
brief_description: Dark burial chamber. Treasure and danger here.
